pages.text: $(italic)Swift, graceful, and hungry. Elves are the best mobile fighters but require more food management.$(/italic)$(br2)$(bold)Racial Traits:$(/bold)$(br2)$(bold)Night Vision$(/bold) — Permanent night vision in dim environments. No UI effect — seamlessly dark to light.$(br2)$(bold)Swift$(/bold) — +10% movement speed permanently. Combines very well with $(thing)Ranger$(/thing), $(thing)Samurai$(/thing), $(thing)Archmage$(/thing).$(br2)$(bold)Fragile$(/bold) — -8% armor effectiveness from all worn armor. The tradeoff for speed.$(br2)$(bold)Hunger Penalty$(/bold) — +20% food drain rate. Fast metabolism is the cost of being an $(thing)Elf$(/thing).
